dish_wagyu_desc: Premium Japanese beef, perfectly grilled with absolute tenderness.
back_desc_wagyu: A5-grade marbling beef sourced from Kobe region. Grilled over binchotan charcoal, melting softly in your mouth with an elegant natural sweetness. Served with Himalayan salt and ponzu sauce.
dish_duck_desc: Traditional French duck confit with crispy skin, meltingly tender meat.
back_desc_duck: Duck cured with herb salt, slow-cooked in duck fat for 8 hours using classic Confit method. Golden crispy skin, tender leg meat. Served with Sarladaise potatoes and red cherry sauce.
dish_lobster_desc: Classic French baked lobster with rich cheese, opulent flavor profile.
back_desc_lobster: Live Maine lobster split and baked in a rich cognac cream and Dijon mustard sauce. Topped with melted golden Gruyère cheese — a classic 19th-century Paris recipe.
about_p1: Officially established in March 2026, CELESTÉ HOUSE is proud to be the ultimate destination for those who appreciate exquisite European cuisine. With a luxurious, captivating space meticulously crafted down to the smallest detail, we deliver a world-class Fine Dining experience in its truest sense.
about_p2: In particular, our signature Wagyu beef has defined our brand legacy from Japan. Crafted by world-class chefs, each beautifully marbled cut is prepared perfectly using traditional methods, keeping its absolute purity and melting tenderness from the very first bite.
tl_step1_desc: Contact us via hotline or website. Confirmed within 15 minutes.
tl_step2_desc: Greeted warmly at the door and guided to your table in a private setting.
tl_step3_desc: Complimentary aperitif served with premium herb-buttered toasted bread.
tl_step4_desc: Wagyu, Duck Confit, or Lobster Thermidor — expertly prepared.
tl_step5_desc: Hot Soufflé, fruit sorbet, and our exclusive specialty Arabica coffee.
dp_desc_default: Reserve your table via our hotline or official website. Our consultants will confirm and note any of your special requirements — food allergies, wine preferences, birthday setups, or anniversary decors.
cta_desc: Experience a romantic dinner within the luxurious ambience of CELESTÉ HOUSE
